objective: Gate4D R8 despliegue real controlado. Usar exactamente la ruta canonica validada en R7: get_connection('migrate'), cursor(as_dict=True), split_sql_batches y ejecucion batch a batch del SQL V2. Sustituir solo el rollback exitoso por commit. En cualquier excepcion hacer rollback. Persistir evidencia durable y exigir postcheck fisico 4/4. No tocar Produccion.

actions.old: - name: R7 canonical runner rollback-only diagnostic
- name: R7 physical postcheck after canonical rollback
actions.new: - name: R8 mandatory physical postcheck 4 of 4

actions.old:
- name: Upload R7 durable diagnostic evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rrr-gate4-r7-canonical-runner-diagnostic-evidence
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/rrr_gate4_r7_diagnostic.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/rrr_gate4_r7_postcheck.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
actions.new:
- name: Upload R8 durable deployment evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rrr-gate4-r8-controlled-deployment-evidence
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/rrr_gate4_r8_deployment.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/rrr_gate4_r8_postcheck.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
